subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice@greenfin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture review

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through GreenFin's use case and requirements. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary workload: customer-facing inference endpoints behind a private VPC (no public egress for model payloads)
- Security: customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained for 7 years, SOC 2 controls required
- Networking: VPC peering or PrivateLink preferred; carrier-grade latency targets for EU/US traffic
- Scale: bursty inference up to 500 concurrent streams, predictable baseline of ~100 TPS

As discussed, the next practical step is a focused architecture review (technical deep dive) to map out network topology, firewall rules, routing, and any on-prem requirements. Proposed goals for the session:

1) Align on network connectivity approach (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink vs. VPN)
2) Identify any infra blockers (proxies, NAT, egress inspection) and required endpoint IPs
3) Confirm KMS/HSM workflow and audit logging expectations
4) Outline a follow-up mutual action plan and timeline for a Private deployment POC

Proposed time slots (all PT):
- Thu, Jul 2 — 10:00 AM PT
- Thu, Jul 2 — 3:00 PM PT

Please let me know who from your side should join (network/infrastructure, security, procurement). Ive CC'd Connor (technical lead) and Dev (solutions) so we can cover deep network and deployment details. Im attaching a short network requirements template and our Private deployment checklist to help structure the discussion.

Attachments: network-requirements-template.pdf; redwood-private-checklist.docx

Thanks — happy to shift times if those don't work.

Best,
